name: Super Duper San Diego 2026

venue.name: UC San Diego
venue.address: Price Center, UCSD, 9500 Gilman Dr, La Jolla, CA 92093

information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SuperDuperSanDiego2026#62228-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [Speedcubeshop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

**UCSD students and UCSD staff can get their registration fee waived!** More details in the **"UCSD Student/Staff Registration Fee Waiver"** tab.

A portion of the profits from this competition will be donated to the Rubik's Cube Club @ UC San Diego, a registered UC San Diego Student Organization.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Njg3OTAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--f0643a286a955df61f35887df56b46d88342d211/image.png)
​
This competition will be streamed live on the [West Coast Cubing](https://www.youtube.com/@WestCoastCubing), [CubersLive](https://www.youtube.com/@Cubers-Live), and [SpeedCubeShop](https://www.youtube.com/@SpeedCubeShopOfficial) YouTube channels.
